dcc.univariate: Demeaned return series; Gaussian GARCH(1,1) MLE
dcc.shrinkage: Ledoit-Wolf analytical nonlinear shrinkage; author-supported replacement for QuEST
dcc.target: Normalize shrunk covariance of GARCH-standardized residuals to correlation
dcc.forecast: Genuine one-step-ahead H, updated on every earlier retained observation

factor.weights: Equal-weight market factor, explicitly authorized by user; general interface accepts historical NxK factor portfolio weights
factor.factor_features: Overlapping daily, weekly(5),monthly(22) lags of matrix-log vech
factor.factor_estimator: Equationwise LASSO or adaptive LASSO; BIC over full LARS knots
factor.beta_estimator: Daily realized loadings (W^T Sigma W)^(-1) W^T Sigma; per-loading OLS HAR
factor.residual: Sector blocks; matrix-log block coordinates; diagonal lag-one predictors only; equationwise LASSO/adaLASSO BIC; exp reconstruction
factor.cleaning: Causal four-standard-deviation, 25%-of-unique-entries screen; replace with preceding 10 nonflagged matrices, training inputs only
factor.sectors: Existing 27-stock sector labels; dataset adaptation from original SIC groups
factor.calendar: Exclude factor features lacking 22 complete preceding screened SPY sessions

evaluation: Same 642 origins (245 development2024,397 reused2025-26); frozen original actual targets and returns
iteration_rule: No test-outcome-driven architecture or parameter changes; retain failed models and all endpoints
qualifications: Full method algorithms with explicit empirical adaptations, not original numerical reproduction
DCC authors use QuEST in original paper and endorse direct analytical shrinkage in package documentation
Residual matrix-log treatment made explicit; Section3.3 presents levels equations and Section5.2 applies log matrix transformation
DCC common-panel returns are intraday open-to-close rather than original CRSP close-to-close; gaps in retained training calendar remain documented
